note: All hypotheses reported; not selecting the highest subjective fit; multiple may remain plausible.
primary_mechanism_descriptive: Divergence originates primarily at the BETA-PREPARATION / raw stage: B1 is already weak under matched RAW (-0.042 vs B0 +0.138), so D1 is not the cause (D1 slightly changes B1 to -0.030). B1 largely PRESERVES B0's pattern (paired trial r high, rotation gain ~0.061) -> mostly per-voxel rescaling, not rotation (supports H-E, not H-F). B1 has lower repeat reliability, most strongly in imagery (0.144 vs B0 0.297) and lower vision SNR (1.80 vs 2.72) (supports H-A). Exploratory, subj01 x V1 only; NOT a causal or population claim.

H-A_beta_prep_reduces_identity_signal.evidence: B1 vision reliability 0.596 vs B0 0.652; SNR B1 1.796 vs B0 2.716; B1 RAW vis2img -0.042

H-B_B1_changes_cross_state_geometry.evidence: B1 cross-state separation 0.184 vs B0 0.200; top1 B1 0.25 vs B0 0.08 (MIXED: separation lower but top1 not lower)

H-C_D1_interacts_adversely_with_B1.evidence: B1 RAW -0.042 vs D1 -0.030; delta_denoise B1 0.012 B0 0.065

H-E_GLMdenoiseRR_mainly_rescales_B0.evidence: paired B0/B1 vision pearson 0.932; scale r2 0.631; rotation gain 0.061

H-F_GLMdenoiseRR_materially_rotates_geom.evidence: paired B0/B1 vision pearson 0.932; rotation gain 0.061
